title: Tech Behind It: A Modern Destination for Technology News, AI Insights, Gadgets, and Digital Innovation
description: New Delhi [India], August 18: The technology industry is moving at an extraordinary pace. Artificial intelligence is transforming the way businesses operate, new gadgets are changing everyday routines, cybersecurity has become a fundamental digital concern, and software innovation continues to reshape how people work, communicate, create, and consume information. In this rapidly evolving environment, staying informed is no longer simply about knowing what is new. It is about understanding why a technology matters, how it works, and what it could mean for users and businesses.

title: Mavrix Makes the Case for Trusted Human Evidence in the AI Era at Quirk's New York
